content.title: About
content.content: Skin‑less chicken meat is a lean source of protein obtained from breast, fillet or other low‑fat parts of the bird, prepared by baking, broiling, grilling or roasting. Cooking without the skin preserves most nutrients and reduces fat content.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Chicken is the most widely consumed poultry worldwide and a staple in many cuisines.
Skin‑less chicken provides about 31 g of protein and less than 3 g of fat per 100 g.
Baking and grilling retain more B‑vitamins compared with deep‑frying.
Chicken is a good source of selenium, a mineral that supports thyroid function and immunity.
When stored properly (at +4 °C for no more than 2 days) chicken stays fresh and safe.

items.title: High‑quality protein
items.content: Protein is essential for tissue growth, repair, and the synthesis of enzymes and hormones.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Removing the skin makes the meat suitable for low‑fat and calorie‑controlled diets.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamin B3 (niacin) and B6 (pyridoxine) support energy metabolism and nervous system health.

items.title: Contains selenium and zinc
items.content: These trace minerals contribute to antioxidant protection and immune function.

items.title: Low glycemic impact
items.content: Chicken does not raise blood sugar levels, which is beneficial for people with diabetes.

items.title: Food‑borne illness risk
items.content: Undercooked chicken may harbor Salmonella; cook to an internal temperature of 75 °C.

items.title: Poultry allergy
items.content: A small number of individuals may experience allergic reactions to chicken proteins.

items.title: Sodium in prepared dishes
items.content: Using pre‑made marinades or sauces can increase the salt content.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Skin‑less chicken can be served hot, added to salads, soups, pasta, rice or vegetable dishes. It is easy to cut into cubes or strips for quick sautéing. When baking, season with herbs, spices and a drizzle of olive oil for flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep fresh chicken in the refrigerator at +2‑+4 °C for up to 2 days. For longer storage, freeze in an airtight bag at ‑18 °C for up to 9 months. Thaw in the fridge, not at room temperature, before cooking.
